ruleDefinitions.name: Certificate Exported Via Certutil.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the certutil with the "exportPFX" flag which allows the utility to export certificates.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertUtil\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-exportPFX\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/exportPFX\\ .*")))
